permitted: The reported values are outputs of a two-dimensional mechanistic simulation or calibrated spatial run.
The expression-reach gap is reported with propagated parameter uncertainty.
The run abstained rather than issuing a stable reachability conclusion.
conditional: Reachability is conditional on the stated vessel concentration, engagement threshold, geometry and parameter ranges.
Barrier attribution is qualitative and is emitted only when uncertainty draws separate one mechanism.
unsupported: A claim that changing the dominant barrier will improve patient outcome.
interval_basis: Empirical 5th-95th percentiles across full-pipeline parameter draws.
